lines.text: The sons of Korah sing that Mount Zion is the city of the great King, like the peaks of Zaphon.
God is in her citadels, and the kings who advanced together fled in terror and trembled.
With a wind from the east God wrecked the ships of Joppa.
Within God's temple they contemplate His loving devotion, and the daughters of Israel rejoice on account of His judgments.
They are told to count her towers and tour her citadels, so they can tell the next generation.
